title: Stack overflow in sensor_task
serial_logs:
***ERROR*** A stack overflow in task sensor_task has been detected.
Backtrace: 0x40081e7a:0x3ffb5b60 0x40089c45:0x3ffb5b80 0x4008a9b2:0x3ffb5ba0
Rebooting...

reference_context.title: ESP-IDF Programming Guide (Espressif)
reference_context.document: ESP-IDF Programming Guide: FreeRTOS (Overview) / ESP-IDF FreeRTOS SMP Changes
reference_context.section: ESP-IDF FreeRTOS SMP Changes > Tasks > Creation (note)
reference_context.snippet: ESP-IDF FreeRTOS also changes the units of ``ulStackDepth`` in the task creation functions. Task stack sizes in Vanilla FreeRTOS are specified in number of words, whereas in ESP-IDF FreeRTOS, the task stack sizes are specified in bytes.

expected.root_cause: sensor_task has a 1024-byte stack but allocates a 2048-byte local buffer, overflowing the stack.
expected.fix: Increase the stack (e.g. 4096) and/or make the buffer static or heap-allocated.
